newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via term RPs Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via term RPs Thursday.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to inject reserves into the banking system via a round of multiple-day fixed-system repurchase agreements on Thursday, economists said.
The Fed added permanent reserves to the banking system on Wednesday, but the size of the operation was less than $2 billion and was unlikely to address the Fed's add need.
Fed funds were trading at 5.56 percent, slightly above the Fed's official target of 5-1/2 percent.
